_meta._doc: ollie · english strings · editorial voice. literal voice variants live in strings.en.literal.json. all keys must exist in both files.

intro.title: hi.
intro.body: ollie sorts what's in your head into the right places. seven small questions before we start — all skippable.

age.title: what's your age range?
age.sub: just so the copy and defaults fit a bit better. skippable.

country.title: where do you live?
country.sub: so on a hard day i can show the right hotline.

menstr.title: do you track a menstrual cycle?
menstr.sub: if no, the cycle module and cycle-related patterns won't show up at all.

goals.title: what brings you here?
goals.sub: pick anything that resonates · multiple is fine.

confirm.body: write whatever's on your mind into the box below. ollie sorts it. if you're in a crisis, it doesn't go to the pattern engine — a quiet hotline number appears.

consent.title: module consents.
consent.sub: choose what you want to use.

confirmation.grocery_running_low: toilet paper szn approaching. adding to your list.
confirmation.finance_bill_upcoming: ${0} is due in ${1} days. just saying.
confirmation.fallback_no_match: didn't fit anywhere. kept it as a dump.

empty.cycle_cold:
tell me when your last period started.
no pressure on the date — close is enough.
empty.sleep_cold: a few more nights. then this means something.
empty.finance_none: no money in or out yet.
empty.focus_idle: what are you with right now
empty.astrology_no_birth: tell me when and where you were born.

cta.cycle: log your last period to begin.

insist.rent_due_today: rent is due in ${0} days. just saying.

crisis.opener_with_name: ${0}, this looks rough. you're not alone.
crisis.opener_no_name: this looks rough. you're not alone.
crisis.close: the dump is here when you're ready.

work.b2: deadlines that feel abstract until they are not.
work.b3: task-switch tax, hyperfocus crash, post-meeting drag.
work.b4: log: tasks, focus minutes, what you finished.
work.b5: patterns surface after enough sessions to see a shape.

habits.b1: daily check-ins. no streaks, no chains.
habits.b2: drift detection — patterns that quietly stopped.
habits.b3: luteal collapse, sensory preflight, friction signature.
habits.b4: log: a quick check on the row when you do it.
habits.b5: patterns surface around 2 weeks of data.

goals.b1: 1 thing at a time. why it matters. when by.
goals.b2: graveyard for what you let go of, on purpose.
goals.b3: research-as-progress mirror, identity drift, novelty discount.
goals.b4: log: a goal, an obstacle, a session tag.
goals.b5: cap of 5 active. anything more dilutes attention.

finance.b2: subscriptions you forgot are still active.
finance.b4: log: a recurring bill, a recent purchase.
finance.b5: no bank link. you tell ollie what to track.

admin.b2: paperwork that needs splitting in half.
admin.b3: the last 5% — finishing what you've already started.
admin.b4: log: a task, even something tiny.
admin.b5: cost-of-delay surfaces when a task ages out.

cycle.b1: cycle day, phase, predicted next period as a range.
cycle.b2: health flags that cite a clinician source. never diagnostic.
cycle.b3: fertility framing only if you opt in.
cycle.b4: log: bleed day 1, cramps, mood, fatigue.

sleep.b2: how sleep loss bleeds into mood and focus the next day.
sleep.b4: log: when you went to bed, when you woke up.
sleep.b5: no scoring, no quality star. raw clock only.

body.b2: interoception drift — when your body asks and you forget.
body.b4: log: a glass of water, a pill, a walk.

pets.b1: feeding, vet, supplies for each resident.
pets.b3: vet adherence delay, schedule lapse under stress.
pets.b4: log: add a pet, mark a feed, log a vet visit.
pets.b5: reminders pause when you mark yourself away.

dump.b1: throw any thought here. ollie sorts it.
dump.b3: good for capturing before working memory drops it.
dump.b4: log: type whatever. one line or a paragraph.
dump.b5: review mode lets you check ollie before it commits.

grocery.b1: what is in your pantry, by fill level.
grocery.b3: shopping mode for in-store. recipes for what you have.
grocery.b4: log: dump groceries — milk, eggs, paper towels.
grocery.b5: no streaks. no rewards. just fill levels.

astrology.b4: log: your birth time and place once.

adherence.body: your last cycle came out to ${0} days. that's unusually long. did you miss logging a period, or was it actually that long?

irregular.copy: cycle pattern is variable. no useful phase this month.

day.empty_sub: no period logged yet. use record below to begin.

next.need_logged: need a logged period to predict.

confidence.cold: first prediction — based on typical cycles
confidence.shifting: pattern shifted — using recent cycles only

pattern.body: ${0} have clustered in your ${1} phase across ${2} cycles. pattern, not medical.

fertility.label: tracking for fertility
fertility.sub: shows fertile window estimate when opted in.

passphrase.label: backup passphrase hint
passphrase.sub: a hint to remember your .void file password.
